    YOUR FIRST BUILD

    Just bring your curiosity.

    Explore inside a computer with your mouse or fingertips.

    Look around

    Drag to rotate. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Use the camera buttons to jump to a different view.

    Learn step by step

    Use the next-step button or turn on autoplay. Switching between assembly and disassembly starts that sequence again.

    Get to know each component

    Click a 3D part or choose a component card below. Exploded view spreads the parts out so you can see how they fit together.

    Connect a desk or build a server

    Use the lab tabs to connect power, USB, HDMI, and LAN. The server lab takes you from rack installation to Linux, SSH, and a web service. Type help in the terminal for supported commands. Progress stays in this page only; refreshing or switching languages starts a new session.

    This learning model simplifies a typical ATX desktop. Check your product manuals for real connectors, mounting methods, and assembly order. Never open the power supply (PSU) enclosure.
